meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: Claude 会帮你查看、添加或删除 NanoClaw 代理容器可访问的主机目录白名单，标明每个目录是只读还是读写。配置写入 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mounts”、“mount allowlist” 等关键词，或要让代理容器访问某个主机目录时触发。

say.text: 看看现在允许代理容器访问哪些目录
say.note: 展示当前白名单及读写权限

say.text: 把 /home/me/data 加到挂载白名单，只读就行
say.note: 校验路径并写入只读配置

say.text: 把 /home/me/data 从挂载白名单里删掉

howto.what_en: Claude can view, add, or remove the host directories NanoClaw agent containers may access, marking each as read-only or read-write. Config lives at ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts," "mount allowlist," or "container mounts," or want an agent container to access a host directory.

say_en.text: Show which directories agent containers can access
say_en.note: Prints the current allowlist and access modes

say_en.text: Add /home/me/data to the mount allowlist as read-only
say_en.note: Validates the path and writes read-only config
Rewrites the config without that entry
